help.short: The resource name of the file share, as seen by the administrator through Azure Resource Manager.
The resource name of the file share, as seen by the administrator through Azure Resource Manager.
Encryption in transit defines whether data is encrypted for NFS shares.
Root squash defines how root users on clients are mapped to the NFS share.
Encryption settings for the file share.
All Customer-managed key encryption properties for the resource.
All identity configuration for Customer-managed key settings defining which identity should be used to auth to Key Vault.

arg.arg: <help short="delegated identity to use for accessing key encryption key Url. Ex: /subscriptions/fa5fc227-a624-475e-b696-cdd604c735bc/resourceGroups//providers/Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities/myId. Mutually exclusive with identityType systemAssignedIdentity and userAssignedIdentity - internal use only."/>

help.short: application client identity to use for accessing key encryption key Url in a different tenant. Ex: f83c6b1b-4d34-47e4-bb34-9d83df58b540
The type of identity to use. Values can be systemAssignedIdentity, userAssignedIdentity, or delegatedResourceIdentity.

arg.arg: <help short="User assigned identity to use for accessing key encryption key Url. Ex: /subscriptions/fa5fc227-a624-475e-b696-cdd604c735bc/resourceGroups//providers/Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities/myId. Mutually exclusive with identityType systemAssignedIdentity."/>

help.short: key encryption key Url, versioned or non-versioned. Ex: https://contosovault.vault.azure.net/keys/contosokek/562a4bb76b524a1493a6afe8e536ee78 or https://contosovault.vault.azure.net/keys/contosokek.
Values are enabled and disabled.
The storage media tier of the file share.
The name of the file share as seen by the end user when mounting the share, such as in a URI or UNC format in their operating system.
The file sharing protocol for this file share.
The provisioned IO / sec of the share.

The provisioned storage size of the share in GiB (1 GiB is 1024^3 bytes or 1073741824 bytes). A component of the file share's bill is the provisioned storage, regardless of the amount of used storage.
The provisioned throughput / sec of the share.
Gets or sets allow or disallow public network access to azure managed file share
The chosen redundancy level of the file share.
The scale mode selected when the file share is created.
The geo-location where the resource lives
Resource tags.
